heroLead: Talk about what it is actually like.
heroBody: Renally is a free programme that connects you with someone who has been on dialysis themselves.
heroNote: * Available soon. Register now and we will let you know as soon as it is live.
conversationBody: With Renally, you have a safe and private place to talk about everyday life, ask about someone else's personal experience and hear what dialysis has been like for them.
topicsIntro: Some questions are easier to ask someone who has been there.
topic1: What the tiredness is actually like
topic2: How to manage work and everyday routines
topic4: How to talk to loved ones about dialysis
topicsOutro: You can talk about these things, and much more. Mentors share insights from their own experience.
twoWaysTitle: Two ways to be part of Renally
talkCardTitle: Talk to someone who's been there
talkCardBody: Renally helps you to connect with mentors who have been on dialysis themselves, whether you're on dialysis, approaching it, or supporting someone who is. You choose who you talk to.
mentorCardBody: If you have been on dialysis, your experience can help someone feel less alone. As a Renally mentor, you can share what it was like for you in one-to-one conversations. You'll receive guidance before you begin.
stepsTitle: One-to-one conversations, built around lived experience
step1Body: They are screened and complete guidance before joining Renally.
step2Title: Talk about everyday life with dialysis
step2Body: One-to-one conversations about things that matter to you.
step3Title: You choose who you talk to
step3Body: See the mentors available, read about their experience and choose who you would like to speak with.
careTitle: Renally works alongside your care team
careBody1: Your care team looks after your health and treatment. Renally allows you to connect with someone who has experienced dialysis themselves.
careBody2: Questions about your health or treatment should always go to your care team.
ctaBody: What you have learned through your own experience could be useful to someone else. Find out what becoming a Renally mentor involves and how to get started.
disclaimer1: Mentors share lived experience, not medical advice.
disclaimer2: Questions about your health should always go to your care team.
